product.name: TerraGlow Solar Lantern 2.0
product.description: The TerraGlow Solar Lantern 2.0 delivers reliable illumination for gardens, patios, and camping sites. Its sleek aluminum housing houses a durable polycarbonate lens that diffuses warm sunset‑orange light across a 120‑degree spread. Equipped with a 2‑cell solar panel and a rechargeable lithium‑ion battery, the lantern charges during daylight and provides up to 10 hours of continuous glow on a single charge. The built‑in LED module offers adjustable brightness levels and a night‑light mode. Weather‑resistant construction ensures operation in rain and dust, while a magnetic base allows easy attachment to metal surfaces. Compact yet powerful, it is an ideal addition to any eco‑friendly outdoor décor.
